description: A WinUI 3 project upgraded to .NET 8 reports NETSDK1206 for `win10-*` runtime identifiers while targeting x64, x86, and ARM64, based on https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml/issues/9107.
prompt:
After moving our WinUI desktop app to .NET 8, the ARM64 package build started warning about runtime identifiers. We already changed the main project to `win-arm64`, but the warning still mentions `win10-arm64`.

```
warning NETSDK1206: Found version-specific or distribution-specific runtime identifier(s): win10-arm64, win10-x64, win10-x86. Affected libraries: Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK. In .NET 8.0 and higher, assets for version-specific and distribution-specific runtime identifiers will not be found by default.
```
